input.text: Electric vehicles produce zero direct emissions during operation, making them cleaner than internal combustion engines at the point of use. However, the total environmental impact depends on electricity generation sources, battery manufacturing processes, and end-of-life recycling. In regions with coal-heavy grids, the lifecycle emissions advantage of EVs is reduced. Battery production requires mining lithium, cobalt, and nickel, which carries environmental and ethical concerns.
